meaning.en: One who registers or is registered.

sentences.en: Antony replied that all registrants of GDC will be able to practice dentistry within their own areas of competence.

sentences.en: Use and exposure categories The UK compromise proposals allow registrants to adopt a voluntary approach to use and exposure categories.

sentences.en: The indexing and lists provide prospective registrants with a structured basis for determining names and viewing those selected by other registrants.

sentences.en: What might be the future of the SEC's requirement for foreign registrants to provide a reconciliation of selected financial information to US GAAP?

sentences.en: Early indications are that existing registrants might continue to be regulated by their current statutory regulator.
